message: Hello
What number of screenshots do you require?
There will be an additional $20 charge for the feature graph.
Hello, I have 6 screenshots from the phone; can you deliver 8 in total? An additional 20 for the android graphic sounds fine as well.
Yes, could we change the hourly payment to a fixed-project fee?
The price for 8 iOS screenshots is $130, plus $20 for the feature graph. The contract would be $150 only.
That price is too high, my friend. I had the android screenshots done for $80. I can pay 100 total, including the android graphic.
Okay, Sir. I will deliver for iOS only (not iPad). Please confirm and then send the contract.
Yes, not iPad. Okay, I’m sending it now.
okay great
I’m beginning the work now. Thanks.
Great! If you have any questions, please let me know.
Hey [FREELANCER_NAME_001], please swap the image I’m attaching here for the 02-ai-skipping.png above, as it is an updated version.
Okay Sir.

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],
Thank you for continuing to collaborate with me! Here is a quick note about the next steps: after the first draft is delivered, we reserve one business day to review and apply your feedback. As soon as you provide final approval for this draft, I will proceed immediately with the Feature Graph.

I look forward to hearing your thoughts!
Best regards,
[FREELANCER_NAME_001]

Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001]! It generally looks great, but I have a few comments for you to address:
1. The first image looks good, although the facial expressions appear upset/sad. Please adjust them to something more appropriate.
2. Please remove the violence pill at the top, while retaining nudity, kissing and profanity. The top photo also depicts active kissing, so please hide it or substitute a photo that implies kissing without actually showing it.
3, 4, 5: These look good.
6. Could you replace this with something demonstrating that it can be watched on any Google TV device?
Hi, thank you for the feedback! I’ve noted all the changes listed above and will share the revised screenshots soon.
Please review the updated screenshots. I’m proceeding with the Feature Graph for the Play Store (1024x500).
Check for the feature graph.

Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_002] screenshots look great. For the graphic, please make these changes:
- Place the phrase "Control What You See" beneath the logo.
- Update the bottom text to read "AI-powered protection for every family member"
Okay Sir
Please check whether any further changes are needed. If everything looks fine, we can move ahead with delivery.
Thanks, [FREELANCER_NAME_001], it looks great. One final comment: please position the Skipifi logo centrally above "Control What You See", and then proceed with delivery.

Attached is the zip file with the ready to upload PNGs. I’m also preparing the Figma file and will send it to you after a few hours.

Please approve the milestone.
Thanks

Attached is the Figma File.

What do you think of my work? If possible, please leave 5 stars of feedback, as it will help me remain top rated. I’m always available for you here.
Thanks.
Thank you, [FREELANCER_NAME_003] looks excellent, and I appreciate how responsive you’ve been!
Great, could you please take a moment to end the contract?
I would also be grateful for 5 stars, since 5 stars help me remain successful and top rated on Upwork.

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],  
I hope the final Skipifi Screenshots delivery meets your expectations. If you need the Android screenshots updated, I’ll do them with the same design for $30 only.
If everything appears satisfactory, I’ll close the contract.  
I’ll also remain available until Aug 14th to handle any bugs, minor adjustments, or questions.  

Thank you.
